scan: every 15 min 10:00-14:30 IST, first signal per stock per day
caveats: Headlines come from Google News RSS filtered by each item's own publication time; its historical archive can be incomplete, so news coverage on old days is thinner than live.
Sentiment uses a finance lexicon (not FinBERT) unless USE_FINBERT=1. Earnings surprise is a headline beat/miss proxy.
NSE derivatives (GEX, OI, IV skew) and pre-open depth are not replayable; those inputs are omitted.
Yahoo serves only ~60 sessions of 5-minute data: a small sample. Treat avg R +/- its standard error, not the P&L, as the evidence.
Entry = next 5-min bar open; stop wins ties inside a bar; exit by 15:15; costs 0.06% round trip; max one trade per stock per day.
Parameters were not tuned on this data, but the same rules produced these results, so beware over-reading any lucky streak.
P&L at 50% risk is shown only for comparison: it is capped at 5x notional and is not a recommended setting.
